## Report

### Summary of Work Completed

I implemented a comprehensive solution to fix the outfit flat-lay image to product list mismatch issue as specified in the chore plan. Here's what was done:

**1. Created Product Visual Validator Utility (`apps/web/lib/utils/product-visual-validator.ts`)**
- New utility (395 lines) with functions:
  - `getImageGenderCategory()` - Detects gender from image URL patterns (oxford, derby, brogue = masculine; heel, pump, mule = feminine)
  - `getTextGenderCategory()` - Detects gender from product name/description keywords
  - `validateProductVisualConsistency()` - Full validation returning issues and confidence score
  - `isVisuallyConsistentForWomen()` - Boolean check for women's outfit inclusion
  - `validateFlatLayThumbnailMatch()` - Validates flat-lay prompt will match product thumbnail
  - `filterVisuallyConsistentProducts()` - Filters products by visual consistency
  - `getVisualConsistencySummary()` - Summary report for debugging/data quality

**2. Enhanced FlatLayItem Type (`apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts`)**
- Added `sku`, `thumbnailUrl`, and `isVisuallyConsistent` fields to FlatLayItem interface

**3. Updated useFlatLayGeneration Hook (`apps/web/lib/hooks/useFlatLayGeneration.ts`)**
- `transformToFlatLayItems()` now returns validation results with issues list
- Added visual consistency validation during transformation
- Logs warnings when mismatches are detected between product descriptions and thumbnails

**4. Enhanced Outfit Generator (`apps/web/lib/outfit-generator.ts`)**
- `filterProductsByGender()` now includes image URL pattern validation
- `isWomenFootwear()` enhanced with visual consistency checking
- Integrated imports from the new visual validator utility

**5. Updated Outfit Combination Rules (`apps/web/lib/styling/outfit-combination-rules.ts`)**
- `validateOutfitComposition()` now checks image URL patterns for masculine footwear
- Full visual consistency check for all outfit items
- Imported and integrated visual validator functions

**6. Added Unit Tests (`apps/web/lib/utils/product-visual-validator.test.ts`)**
- 32 test cases covering all validation scenarios (353 lines)
- Tests for masculine/feminine URL patterns, text keywords, edge cases, and filtering

### Files Changed

```
apps/web/lib/utils/product-visual-validator.ts      | 395 (new)
apps/web/lib/utils/product-visual-validator.test.ts | 353 (new)
apps/web/lib/types/image-types.ts                   |   6 +
apps/web/lib/hooks/useFlatLayGeneration.ts          | ~60 lines modified
apps/web/lib/outfit-generator.ts                    | ~80 lines modified
apps/web/lib/styling/outfit-combination-rules.ts    | ~30 lines modified
```

**Total: ~924 lines added across 6 files**

### Validation Results

- **Linting**: Pre-existing warnings/errors only (no new issues from this implementation)
- **TypeScript**: Compiles successfully (pre-existing vite plugin type errors only)
- **Tests**: All 424 tests pass, including 32 new visual validator tests
